reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing DeepSeek Harness web theme package: it customizes the chat interface’s appearance and ambience through theme registration, background media, particles, animations, and control overlays. Evidence shows no broader automation, data pipelines, external service integrations, or developer tooling behavior beyond interface theming and local media/audio customization.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的主题插件，为界面提供萤火风格视觉皮肤，并支持壁纸、粒子、开屏动画和音频效果等界面定制。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI theme plugin that adds Firefly-style visual customization, including wallpapers, particles, boot animation, and audio effects for the chat interface.

capabilities: Registers and applies a DSH theme through client theme runtime hooks.
Injects custom UI styles/visual effects (wallpaper layers, particles, boot animation, gradient overlays).
Lets users switch and randomize local/static or video wallpapers with persisted preferences.
Supports local media import (image/video) for wallpaper assets with client-side storage.
Adds a music player and typing audio effects within the chat UI.
Provides message-triggered sticker/easter-egg overlays and quick controls for media/theme toggles.

reasons.code: The plugin is declared as a DSH web client plugin that injects UI-theme modules.
README describes full-screen image/video wallpaper system, random switching, and persistence behavior.
README details right-side controls for sound, particles, wallpaper, and music, plus boot animation and input-based triggers.
Repository structure includes assets, GIF, music, and a build step that bundles client-side UI resources.
